title: Direct Creator DM Outreach - Week 1 Plan
body:
# Direct Creator DM Outreach - Week 1 Execution Plan

## Target Profile
Independent Music Producers/Beatmakers with:
- 500-10k followers (established but not mega-famous)
- Active in last 7 days
- Posted about beats, selling music, platform frustrations
- Located globally, focus on US/UK/EU timezones

## Daily Outreach: 10 DMs
Focus: Personalized, problem-focused, no hard sell

### Message Framework
1. Acknowledgment - Reference their recent post/work
2. Problem Validation - Mention specific pain point
3. BroLab Value - Instant delivery, 0% commission
4. Soft CTA - 'Would love your thoughts'
5. No Pressure - Clear its optional

## Daily Execution (Monday-Friday)
- Source 10 producer profiles
- Personalize DMs based on their work/pain points
- Send from relevant account
- Track all responses

## Response Protocol

### Positive Responses
- Send demo link + offer walkthrough
- Provide early access code
- Answer questions within 2 hours
- Track as warm lead

### No Response / Neutral
- One follow-up after 3-5 days
- Don't over-persist
- Move to next prospect

### Negative
- Thank them, respect choice
- Note feedback for future messaging

## Week 1 Tracking
- DMs sent: 50 total
- Response rate target: 10-20%
- Genuine interest: 3-5 people
- Demo requests: 2-3
- Trial signups: 1-2
- Paying conversions: 1-2 (PRIMARY GOAL)

## Sources for Prospecting
- Twitter: 'selling beats', 'beat frustration', 'platform fees'
- Instagram music producer communities
- Reddit: r/makinghiphop, r/trapproduction comments
- SoundBetter/Beatstars reviews and forums
- Music producer Discord communities

## Key Rules
- Be authentic and personalized
- Reference specific work/achievement
- Focus on their problems
- No spam language or robotic tone
- Best times: 9am-5pm their timezone
- Track everything
- Respect boundaries
